crossRefs.note: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,
For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.
But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and…
For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and…
Therefore since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and…
If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.
If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be…

parallels.note: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and…

translations.web: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.
translations.bsb: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
translations.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
translations.asv: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken through.
